# Proofs

::: {#thm-sum .theorem}
## Sum of two even numbers
The sum of two even numbers is even.
:::

::: {#prf-sum .proof}
Let $a = 2m$ and $b = 2n$. Then $a + b = 2(m + n)$.
:::

::: {#rem-terms .remark}
This also holds for any number of terms.
:::

::: {#sol-example .solution}
Take $m = 1, n = 2$, so $a + b = 6$.
:::

By @thm-sum, the claim follows. The proof is in @prf-sum, a remark is in @rem-terms, and a worked example is in @sol-example.
